Natural Language Query: Show me my investors / List all investors / Pull up investor list / Show all investors
Parameter That Changes: All parameters are null or ALL
What Changes vs Default: This is the default call. No filters applied. Returns all investors for that ARN.

Natural Language Query: Show eligible investors / Who has email registered / Show investors with email
Parameter That Changes: eligibility param changes from ALL to YES
What Changes vs Default: Second parameter changes from ALL to YES. Only investors with an email in customer_master are returned.

Natural Language Query: Show investors without email / Who is not eligible / Investors missing contact details
Parameter That Changes: eligibility param changes from ALL to NO
What Changes vs Default: Second parameter changes from ALL to NO. Only investors without an email are returned.

Natural Language Query: Show investors with OTM / Who has mandate set up / Who has auto debit enabled / OTM registered investors
Parameter That Changes: otm param changes from ALL to Y
What Changes vs Default: Third parameter changes from ALL to Y. Function checks multiple_bank table for valid OTM - om_umrn not null, cease_dt null or future, paymech supports OTM.

Natural Language Query: Show investors without OTM / Who has no mandate / Who hasn't registered OTM / No auto debit
Parameter That Changes: otm param changes from ALL to NOT_AVAILABLE
What Changes vs Default: Third parameter changes from ALL to NOT_AVAILABLE. Returns investors who do not have a valid OTM.

Natural Language Query: Show active investors / Who transacted recently / Investors active in last 6 months / Who has been investing
Parameter That Changes: investortype param changes from ALL to ACTIVE
What Changes vs Default: Fourth parameter changes from ALL to ACTIVE. Checks customer_schemes for last transaction date within 180 days.

Natural Language Query: Show dormant investors / Who hasn't transacted in a while / Inactive investors / No recent activity
Parameter That Changes: investortype param changes from ALL to DORMANT
What Changes vs Default: Fourth parameter changes from ALL to DORMANT. Checks customer_schemes for last transaction date 180 or more days ago.

Natural Language Query: Show CGF investors / Which investors hold CGF schemes
Parameter That Changes: investorsubtype array gets CGF added
What Changes vs Default: Fifth parameter changes from empty array to ARRAY['CGF']. Checks scheme_setup for cgf_flag = C and plan_type not D.

Natural Language Query: Show minor investors / Investors who are minors / Minor accounts
Parameter That Changes: investorsubtype array gets MINOR added
What Changes vs Default: Fifth parameter changes to ARRAY['MINOR']. Checks tax_status table for minor_flag = Y.

Natural Language Query: Show others / Non CGF non minor investors
Parameter That Changes: investorsubtype array gets OTHERS added
What Changes vs Default: Fifth parameter changes to ARRAY['OTHERS']. Returns investors who are neither CGF nor Minor.

Natural Language Query: Show CGF and minor investors / Investors who are CGF or minor
Parameter That Changes: investorsubtype array gets both CGF and MINOR
What Changes vs Default: Fifth parameter changes to ARRAY['CGF','MINOR']. Returns investors who are CGF or Minor or both.

Natural Language Query: Show investors who currently hold units / Who is currently invested / Investors with active holdings / Who has money in a fund
Parameter That Changes: holding parameter passes ROW with WITH value
What Changes vs Default: Sixth parameter changes from null to ROW with WITH. Checks processed_trxns - units bought minus units sold greater than zero.

Natural Language Query: Show investors with no holdings / Who has zero balance / Who has fully exited / Investors not holding anything
Parameter That Changes: holding parameter passes ROW with WITHOUT value
What Changes vs Default: Sixth parameter changes from null to ROW with WITHOUT. Returns investors where net unit balance is zero.

Natural Language Query: Show investors with SIP / Who has active SIP / SIP investors
Parameter That Changes: systematic parameter passes ROW with SIP
What Changes vs Default: Seventh parameter changes from null to ROW with WITH and SIP. Checks SIPSTP table for active SIP registrations.

Natural Language Query: Show investors without SIP / Who has no SIP running
Parameter That Changes: systematic parameter passes ROW with WITHOUT and SIP
What Changes vs Default: Same as above but WITH changes to WITHOUT. Returns investors with no active SIP.

Natural Language Query: Show investors with STP / Who has STP active
Parameter That Changes: systematic parameter passes ROW with STP
What Changes vs Default: Seventh parameter uses STP in the plan type array. Checks SIPSTP table for active STP.

Natural Language Query: Show investors with SWP / Who has SWP active
Parameter That Changes: systematic parameter passes ROW with SWP
What Changes vs Default: Seventh parameter uses SWP. Checks SIPSTP table for active SWP.

Natural Language Query: Show investors with DTP / Who has dividend transfer plan
Parameter That Changes: systematic parameter passes ROW with DTP
What Changes vs Default: Seventh parameter uses DTP. Checks DTP_REGN table for active DTP plans.

Natural Language Query: Show investors with FlexSIP / Who has FlexSIP active
Parameter That Changes: systematic parameter passes ROW with FLEXSIP
What Changes vs Default: Seventh parameter uses FLEXSIP. Checks SIPSTP table for active FlexSIP.

Natural Language Query: Show investors with FlexIndex / Who has FlexIndex active
Parameter That Changes: systematic parameter passes ROW with FLEXINDEX
What Changes vs Default: Seventh parameter uses FLEXINDEX. Checks TRIGGER_TRXN table for FlexIndex setups.

Natural Language Query: Show investors with SwingSTP
Parameter That Changes: systematic parameter passes ROW with SWINGSTP
What Changes vs Default: Seventh parameter uses SWINGSTP. Checks SIPSTP table for SwingSTP.

Natural Language Query: Show investors with SmartSwap
Parameter That Changes: systematic parameter passes ROW with SMARTSWAP
What Changes vs Default: Seventh parameter uses SMARTSWAP. Checks SIPSTP table for SmartSwap.

Natural Language Query: Show investors with any systematic plan / Who has any recurring investment
Parameter That Changes: systematic parameter passes ROW with all plan types
What Changes vs Default: Seventh parameter includes all plan types in the array.

Natural Language Query: Show investors with no systematic plan / Who has no SIP or STP
Parameter That Changes: systematic WITH changes to WITHOUT
What Changes vs Default: Same as above but WITH changes to WITHOUT.

Natural Language Query: Who bought units recently / Show investors who made a purchase / Recent purchase activity
Filter Being Applied: Investor Activity = WITH, type PURCHASE, last 1 month
Parameter That Changes: activity parameter passes ROW with PURCHASE
Full Function Call: select * from filter_dp_investor_menu('ARN-XXXX','ALL','ALL','ALL',ARRAY[]::TEXT[],(null),(null), ROW('WITH', ARRAY['PURCHASE'], ARRAY['ALL'], ARRAY['Z','N','Y'], '1 month'),null,'first_name','ASC','25',0,'Y')
What Changes vs Default: Eighth parameter changes from null to ROW with WITH, PURCHASE, and time window. Checks processed_trxns for purchase type transactions.

Natural Language Query: Who redeemed recently / Show investors with recent redemption
Filter Being Applied: Investor Activity = WITH, type REDEMPTION, last 1 month
Parameter That Changes: activity parameter passes ROW with REDEMPTION
Full Function Call: select * from filter_dp_investor_menu('ARN-XXXX','ALL','ALL','ALL',ARRAY[]::TEXT[],(null),(null), ROW('WITH', ARRAY['REDEMPTION'], ARRAY['ALL'], ARRAY['Z','N','Y'], '1 month'),null,'first_name','ASC','25',0,'Y')
What Changes vs Default: Eighth parameter uses REDEMPTION as the transaction type.

Natural Language Query: Who did a switch recently / Show investors with switch activity
Filter Being Applied: Investor Activity = WITH, type SWITCH, last 1 month
Parameter That Changes: activity parameter passes ROW with SWITCH
Full Function Call: select * from filter_dp_investor_menu('ARN-XXXX','ALL','ALL','ALL',ARRAY[]::TEXT[],(null),(null), ROW('WITH', ARRAY['SWITCH'], ARRAY['ALL'], ARRAY['Z','N','Y'], '1 month'),null,'first_name','ASC','25',0,'Y')
What Changes vs Default: Eighth parameter uses SWITCH as the transaction type.

Natural Language Query: Show investors with SIP transactions / Who had SIP instalment recently
Filter Being Applied: Investor Activity = WITH, type SIP, last 1 month
Parameter That Changes: activity parameter passes ROW with SIP
Full Function Call: select * from filter_dp_investor_menu('ARN-XXXX','ALL','ALL','ALL',ARRAY[]::TEXT[],(null),(null), ROW('WITH', ARRAY['SIP'], ARRAY['ALL'], ARRAY['Z','N','Y'], '1 month'),null,'first_name','ASC','25',0,'Y')
What Changes vs Default: Eighth parameter uses SIP as the transaction type. Checks processed_trxns for SIP instalment transactions.

Natural Language Query: Show investors with any recent transaction / Who has been transacting
Filter Being Applied: Investor Activity = WITH, all types, last 1 month
Parameter That Changes: activity parameter passes ROW with all transaction types
What Changes vs Default: Eighth parameter includes all transaction types in the array.

Natural Language Query: Find investor named Rahul / Search for Priya / Look up investor Amit
Parameter That Changes: searchtext parameter gets the name
What Changes vs Default: The ninth parameter changes from null to the name typed. ILIKE search on first_name.
